text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm so tireeed~~ I can't take it 
anymoreee~~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her inability to hold her ground at the 
finish has been noticeable lately. The 
training menu is only going to get tougher 
from here... This is where she needs to 
step up her game.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you tell me ‘the secret to 
holding back’... I mean, I wanna get 
faster, but I just don't get it—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's a new item! And it looks so 
delicious!! ...N-No, don't look, don't 
look~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I want to say yes right now! 
I want to gaze upon you eating your fill, 
my Liege... But one must not interfere 
with their fave! I must endure—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, I took a look at the girls who 
are holding back, and...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nope, no way, I can't do this! It's making 
me restless! I just gotta stay true to my 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, on my end, I really want her to 
develop perseverance and self-control 
somehow—
choice_data_list:
How about starting by holding back for 
just one second?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
One second? ...Wait, if I hold out for 
just one second, does that mean I can do 
whatever I want after?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list:
Totally! 1 is better than 0, and 2 is 
better than 1, right?

Totally! 1 is better than 0, and 2 is 
better than 1, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! I see... that'll do just 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you a genius!? Totally! That's 
so amazing~♡
choice_data_list:
Tomorrow, let's try to hold out for two 
more seconds

Tomorrow, let's try to hold out for two 
more seconds, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And from the very next day, Fusaichi 
Pandora seemed to show just a bit more 
tenacity in her running.
